<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>clckr. - a clicker game for android</title>
<meta name="description" content="clckr. is a minimal clicker game for android with live skins, daily quests and ranked battles.">
<style>
:root{--bg:#F3F4F7;--surf:#FFFFFF;--var:#E9EBF0;--line:#D0D4DC;--fg:#14161B;--mut:#4A4F5A;--soft:#2B2F38;--btn:#14161B;--btn-fg:#FFFFFF;--acc:#14161B;--glow:rgba(20,22,27,.10);box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0B0C0F;--surf:#15171C;--var:#1D2027;--line:#30343D;--fg:#F2F3F5;--mut:#9AA0AB;--soft:#C9CCD3;--btn:#FFFFFF;--btn-fg:#0B0C0F;--acc:#FFFFFF;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0B0C0F;--surf:#15171C;--var:#1D2027;--line:#30343D;--fg:#F2F3F5;--mut:#9AA0AB;--soft:#C9CCD3;--btn:#FFFFFF;--btn-fg:#0B0C0F;--acc:#FFFFFF;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg)}
a{color:var(--soft);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--fg)}
a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:3px}
h1,p{margin:0}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div style="background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;line-height:1.5">
 
<div style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1px">clckr<span style="color:var(--acc)">.</span></div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 26px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500">
<a href="#features">features</a><a href="#showcase">showcase</a>
<a href="#download" style="background:var(--btn);color:var(--btn-fg);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700">download</a>
</div>
</div>
 
<div style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px 24px 90px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:56px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<div style="flex:1 1 440px;min-width:0">
<div style="display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--soft)">beta 1.2 / android 11+</div>
<h1 style="margin:22px 0 16px;font-size:clamp(38px,9.5vw,64px);line-height:1.04;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-2.5px">tap. upgrade.<br>climb the ranks.</h1>
<p style="margin:0 0 30px;font-size:18px;color:var(--mut);max-width:520px">clckr. is a minimal clicker game for android. buy autoclickers, collect live skins and accessories, beat daily quests and battle for a place on the global leaderboard.</p>
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<a href="#download" style="background:var(--btn);color:var(--btn-fg);padding:16px 30px;border-radius:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px">download the apk</a>
<a href="#showcase" style="border:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 30px;border-radius:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px">see it in action</a>
</div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1 1 320px;display:flex;justify-content:center">
<div style="width:340px;height:340px;max-width:100%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow),transparent 68%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center">
<div style="width:230px;height:230px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surf);border:4px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center">
<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--mut)">tap</div>
<div style="font-size:54px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-2px">+1</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
 
<div id="features" style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 24px 90px">
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:28px"><div style="width:4px;height:16px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--acc)"></div><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--soft)">features</div><div style="flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)"></div></div>
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px">
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">01</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">click and upgrade</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">autoclickers, faster speeds and click multipliers, with bulk buying for big jumps.</div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">02</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">skins that move</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">a watch, radar, speedometer, light bulb and vinyl record that react to every tap.</div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">03</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">colors and accessories</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">solid colors, gradients and a custom picker, plus a crown, halo, top hat, headphones and more.</div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">04</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">daily quests</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">beat the clock for a bonus reward and keep your daily streak alive.</div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">05</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">ranked battles</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">face a bot on easy, medium or hard, earn elo and climb the top 100 and global leaderboards.</div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--acc)">06</div><div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 6px">cloud account</div><div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)">sign up to keep your progress saved and your name on the leaderboard. light, dark and custom accent themes included.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
 
<div id="showcase" style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 90px">
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:34px"><div style="width:4px;height:16px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--acc)"></div><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--soft)">showcase</div><div style="flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)"></div></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:40px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start">
<figure style="margin:0;text-align:center"><div style="width:260px;max-width:100%;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);padding:8px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="The clckr. home screen with the click counter, the big click button and the bottom navigation bar" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:32px"></div><figcaption style="margin-top:16px;font-weight:700">tap, upgrade, repeat</figcaption></figure>
<figure style="margin:0;text-align:center"><div style="width:260px;max-width:100%;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);padding:8px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="The skins panel listing colors with equipped and select buttons" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:32px"></div><figcaption style="margin-top:16px;font-weight:700">make it yours</figcaption></figure>
<figure style="margin:0;text-align:center"><div style="width:260px;max-width:100%;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);padding:8px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Ranked mode with easy, medium and hard battles" style="display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:32px"></div><figcaption style="margin-top:16px;font-weight:700">pick your fight</figcaption></figure>
</div>
</div>
 
<div id="download" style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 80px">
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:28px"><div style="width:4px;height:16px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--acc)"></div><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--soft)">download</div><div style="flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)"></div></div>
<div style="background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(22px,5vw,40px);display:flex;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
<div style="flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0">
<div style="font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:24px">get clckr. for android</div>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/defaulty0100/clckr./releases" style="display:inline-block;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btn-fg);padding:16px 34px;border-radius:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px">download clckr.apk</a>
</div>
<div style="flex:1 1 320px;min-width:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--soft)">
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px"><div style="font-weight:800;color:var(--acc)">1</div><div>choose the latest release</div></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px"><div style="font-weight:800;color:var(--acc)">2</div><div>download clckr.apk</div></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:14px"><div style="font-weight:800;color:var(--acc)">3</div><div>open the file, tap install, and start clicking.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
 
<div style="max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 24px 40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px">
<div style="font-weight:800">clckr<span style="color:var(--acc)">.</span></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:22px"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@clckrdev">tiktok</a><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://t.me/clckrdev">telegram</a></div>
</div>
 
</div>
 
</body>
</html>
